I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team. The new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. My reply says Gate 47 replaces the Dock 23 I repeated earlier.

Her first post and my first reply still say Dock 23. Only she can edit or delete her post if she doesn't want anyone going by the old number.
